headline: No direct store anywhere in the image writes the normalized struct byte at 0x4ecc+0x0c or +0x0d. The ONLY writer of those bytes is the 28-byte whole-struct copy at 0x1e0dadc. The struct is ASSEMBLED in a stack buffer at sp+1080 by two source-specific producers called immediately before the compare.

writer_enumeration.method: scanned every instruction accessing [reg + off] for off in 0x8c..0xa0 with per-function register-base resolution (immediate loads and simple pointer copies) against base 0x4e40, i.e. the struct at 0x4ecc
writer_enumeration.result_for_0x4ed8_0x4ed9: ZERO direct stores. The 65 raw offset hits all resolve to other base registers or to bases that cannot be shown to be 0x4e40, e.g. 0x1e0ac30 r1 = [r9 + 0x98] where r9 = 0x8a0 (so 0x938, the command queue, not the input state).

only_writer.condition: executed only after 0x1e0dad2 finds the compared 14 bytes DIFFERENT

writer_enumeration.consequence: 0x4ecc is a mirror of the last SENT state, not the live state. The live state is the stack buffer at sp+1080, so the update condition question moves to the producers of sp+1080.

sequence: 1e0da42-1e0da52: a packed value r13 is assembled from a source word (bit inserts and rev8)
normalized_state_producers.interpretation: a source mux: the low nibble and the high nibble of r2 select which producer fills the 28-byte normalized struct at sp+1080. Both producers receive the struct pointer and the selector.
normalized_state_producers.critical_detail: the LT/RT DIGITAL bits are written into struct+0x0c/+0x0d from packed bits 8 and 9 BEFORE the producers run, so the producers may overwrite them with the analog values. That ordering is exactly what a bit-vs-analog overlap needs.
normalized_state_producers.next: reverse 0x1e0a5f2 and 0x1e0a656 - they are the real normalized-state writers and therefore the real answer to when RT is refreshed.

rt_pipeline.status: NOT YET PROVEN - but the search space collapsed to two functions
rt_pipeline.known: bit 9 of the packed trigger word maps to struct+0x0d, which matches the live RT digital id 9 / mask 0x00000200 only in *bit id*, not yet in mask placement
rt_pipeline.warning: do not infer that +0x0d is digital-only; the producers likely write the analogue 0..255 value over it

contradiction_candidates_resolved.raw RT changes elsewhere but +0x0d updat: SUPPORTED by structure - +0x0d is written by the whole-struct copy only after a change, and the producers run in the reported pipeline
contradiction_candidates_resolved.USB parser commits state conditionally: CONSISTENT with the r2-nibble mux at 0x1e0da66/0x1e0da76
contradiction_candidates_resolved.trigger processing suppresses normalized: NOT SUPPORTED by any code read yet
